question: How is the first divine lotus to be visualized in meditation?
premises: The object of meditation is a divine lotus.
This lotus has eight spokes or petals.
It is adorned by the first octad.
inference: The first meditation envisions a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āra can mean spoke or petal in lotus imagery
plain_english: Visualize a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
